items.title: Updated UK guidance for finerenone introduces new treatment for HF patients
items.summary: New guidance from NICE provide a framework for UK care providers using finerenone to manage the treatment of certain types of heart failure.

items.title: LEO outlays $435m for rights to Tanabe’s rare disease drug for sun-induced pain
items.summary: Tanabe’s dersimelagon is already under FDA review having achieved positive Phase III results earlier this year.

items.title: Faeth’s PIKTOR plus paclitaxel combo gains FDA fast track status
items.summary: Faeth Therapeutics has received fast track designation from the FDA for the PIKTOR with paclitaxel combination to treat advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer.

items.title: Fulcrum and Slate Medicines sign merger agreement
items.summary: Fulcrum Therapeutics and Slate Medicines have signed a definitive agreement to merge in an all-stock transaction backed by a $245m private placement financing from a syndicate of healthcare investors.

items.title: Moving at the speed of pharma digitalisation: driving ROI from AI and digital tools
items.summary: Discover how GSK, Boehringer Ingelheim, Takeda and more than 100 pharma leaders scale digital projects at AUTOMA+ 2026 in Switzerland.
